gempauth-unavailable: Login error when GEMP cannot be reached or answers wrongly.
gempauth-banned: Login error for a permanently banned GEMP account.
gempauth-temp-banned: Login error for a suspended GEMP account. $1 - end of the suspension.
gempauth-throttled: Login refused because GEMP's login throttle (or the wiki-auth endpoint limit) is active. $1 - wait time (duration).
gempauth-reset-required: Login refused: the password was a valid GEMP one-time reset code. Tells the user to finish the reset on GEMP. $1 - GEMP URL.
gempauth-deactivated: Login refused: the GEMP account is deactivated.
gempauth-name-invalid: Login refused: GEMP's canonical name is not a valid MediaWiki user name.
gempauth-link-mismatch: Login error when the wiki name is linked to another GEMP id.
gempauth-password-on-gemp: Shown instead of the wiki password change/reset for GEMP-linked accounts. $1 - GEMP URL.
gempauth-confirm-email-to-edit: Permission error for users without a confirmed email on content pages.
gempauth-local-case-variant: Login refused locally (GEMP not contacted): the typed name matches an existing wiki account that is not linked to GEMP, ignoring case. $1 - that account's name.
